## Commits (1)

### `805d404` feat(count): count tokens with each model's encoding, exact via api
Claude, 2026-10-09

> Every count used cl100k_base, which is GPT-4's encoding: OpenAI models
> since GPT-4o use o200k_base, and Claude, Gemini and the other vendors
> use their own tokenizers, so the "Exact" label was only true for GPT-4.
>
> - --target-model picks the tiktoken encoding: o200k_base for GPT-4o,
>   GPT-4.1, GPT-5, GPT-6 and o-series models, cl100k_base otherwise.
> - Labels say when a count only approximates the model's tokenizer
>   (Claude, Gemini and other vendors, GPT-6 whose encoding is
>   unpublished, and the estimation fallback, which was labelled "Exact").
>   The @anthropic-ai/tokenizer package is the Claude 2 tokenizer and is
>   now labelled as an approximation.
> - New `ctxman count [path|-] --model ID [--api] [--json]`: counts a
>   project or piped text for a model and checks it against the window.
>   With --api it counts Claude models exactly through Anthropic's
>   count_tokens endpoint (free, nothing generated; needs the
>   @anthropic-ai/sdk package and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), batching files into
>   as few requests as possible and redacting secrets before sending.
> - tiktoken moves to dependencies so a plain `npm install ctxman` counts
>   exactly instead of estimating.
>
> Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
